_comment: Image-mode (non-logo) prompt templates for the Logo Generator's 'Image' mode. Edit strings here; variable substitution happens at runtime. Variables: {style_direction} (art-direction phrase for the selected style), {subject} (user description), {size} (composition/aspect phrase), {colors} (color instruction or empty), {bg} (background phrase or empty).
template: A high-quality {style_direction} image of {subject}. {size}. Only include the requested subject and explicitly requested supporting elements; do not add people, buildings, vehicles, mountains, terrain, horizon lines, foreground objects, or extra scenery unless the description asks for them. {colors}{bg}Rich detail, balanced lighting, professional composition. Do not include any logos, watermarks, captions, or text or lettering unless it is explicitly part of the described subject.

style_direction.fantasy: epic fantasy art style, magical and ornate, painterly
style_direction.retro: vintage retro, nostalgic color grading, classic
style_direction.minimalist: minimalist, lots of negative space, simple and clean
style_direction.greetingcard: hand-painted watercolor illustration, soft washes and paper texture
style_direction.photorealistic: photorealistic, professional photography, sharp focus and natural lighting
style_direction.chrome: glossy 3D chrome render, reflective metallic surfaces, studio-lit

size_direction.16:9: Wide 16:9 aspect ratio with horizontal framing
size_direction.9:16: Tall 9:16 aspect ratio with vertical framing
